next.reason: 1985: 'The data description of each parameter in the BY CONTENT phrase ... must be the same, meaning no conversion'; 2023: 'the formal parameter shall be of the same length as the corresponding argument; ...rules are the same as for a MOVE statement'. 1985 requires an identical description for BY CONTENT. 2023 requires only equal length for a plain CALL, and allows MOVE/COMPUTE conversion with a prototype or NESTED.
